taste.name: The photo is the card
taste.trigger: When facing a grid of dishes to compare
taste.decision: Chose an unframed square photo with text set directly on the page over a white card with border, shadow and padding
taste.reason: Because people choose food with their eyes; a frame around each dish makes you look at the frames

taste.name: Rooms, not boxes
taste.trigger: When one topic had to be separated from the next
taste.decision: Chose full-width background colour changes and 120px of air over cards, dividers and shadows
taste.reason: Because a change of wall colour tells you that you walked into another room without anyone drawing a line on the floor

taste.name: One loud thing per screen
taste.trigger: When the order action had to be findable everywhere
taste.decision: Chose a single high-voltage accent on under 3% of the surface over spreading brand colour across headers, icons and links
taste.reason: Because when only one thing shouts, nobody has to hunt for the button
evidence: all other colours are green-tinted neutrals (#00473C, #0E150E)

taste.name: Hierarchy by size, tight inside and wide outside
taste.trigger: When setting the type and spacing scale
taste.decision: Chose huge thin headings and a two-speed spacing scale over bold weights and evenly graded gaps
taste.reason: Because a big quiet headline reads as confidence, and things that sit close together are understood as one thing
